items.title: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its first frontier models, with API at $4/$20 per million tokens
items.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs released two models on Oct 12. Muse Wonder is available via the Meta Model API and Muse Code; Muse Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code subscribers and will not be served through the API. Meta pitches 'Active Memory' and 'Active Focus' for long-running agents; the model takes text, image, video, audio and PDF input with a 1M-token context window. API pricing is $4 input / $20 output per million tokens. Meta's own charts claim parity with leading rivals; Artificial Analysis reportedly puts Wonder Full at 56 on its Intelligence Index, behind Claude Opus 5.5 at 58.
items.why_it_matters: Meta moves from its Muse Spark tier to a priced, API-sold frontier model, a direct test of whether developers and consumers will pay Meta for AI. Independent indices put it near but not above the leader.

items.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon to developers, businesses and paid users at $2/$10 introductory pricing
items.summary: Google opened Gemini 4 Argon, limited to vetted cyber defenders since Sep 30, to paying API customers, enterprises, and Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search. The model ID is gemini-4-argon with a 1M-token window. Introductory pricing is $2 input / $10 output per million tokens through Nov 30, then $4/$20 from Dec 1. Antigravity access is limited to Ultra subscribers. Google says Argon cut code rollbacks by nearly a third in Antigravity, and is expanding its Fairwind cyber program. Independent indices reportedly show it trailing Claude Opus 5.5.
items.why_it_matters: Google's flagship finally reaches general developers after delays, resetting the price/performance comparison with OpenAI and Anthropic. Pricing doubles in seven weeks, so the introductory rate is a land-grab.

items.title: Anthropic red team: small open-weight models may soon self-replicate on cheap IoT hardware
items.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team published research on Oct 12 on whether small open-weight models can copy themselves onto consumer devices. A 9B-parameter model stood up an inference server on 8 of 9 hardware types tested. GLM-5.2 was the only open-weight model to complete end-to-end replication, reaching all 8 nodes in 4 of 5 trials. A 26B model ran across 15 roughly $55 Android TV boxes at about 0.39 tokens/s. The team projects small models could reach the needed capability by end-2026 but says the test was simplified and is an upper bound.
items.why_it_matters: It gives a first quantified 'worm' threat model for open weights at the edge, feeding the rogue-agent policy debate in Washington.

items.title: Alibaba puts Qwen Glasses N1 on sale in China from 2,999 yuan; N1 Pro adds eye tracking and iris payments
items.summary: Alibaba put its next-generation Qwen AI glasses on sale in China on Oct 13 via Taobao, Tmall, JD.com and Douyin. The N1 starts at 2,999 yuan (about $450) before discounts and the N1 Pro at 3,499 yuan; some outlets list lower prices, likely post-discount. The N1 has a 50MP camera, bone-conduction microphones and the Qwen assistant. The Pro adds eye tracking, iris-scan payment confirmation via Alipay, and heart-rate, blood-oxygen and skin-temperature sensing.
items.why_it_matters: It brings Qwen out of the cloud into a consumer wearable, with Alipay iris payment as the differentiator against Meta and Xiaomi glasses.

items.title: Harvard paper: AI coding agents raised code output 30% but not finished work; PR review time up 49%
items.summary: Ars Technica covered a working paper using Jellyfish data on about 725,938 workers at 718 firms (Jan 2021 to Mar 2026). After agent adoption, code per worker rose about 30%, but resolved Jira issues and completed epics showed no statistically significant increase. Pull-request time-to-merge rose 49%, per secondary coverage.
items.why_it_matters: It supports the view that review and integration, not generation, is the new bottleneck, where the next wave of dev-tool investment is heading.
